about: Carries travellers by boat for a fare (carriage-or-boat).
Keeps the peace: a member of the place's guard (in Black Marsh, often a tribal levy).
Keeps the inn, sells food and drink, rents a bed.
Holds the place or speaks for it.
Lives and works in the place; no service the place promises.
Works the forge and sells arms and armour (trader-blacksmith).
Sells spell tomes and magic goods (trader-spells).
